senses.en: reacting too strongly to criticism or minor things; easily upset
senses.zh: 过度敏感的；神经过敏的

example.en: He is hypersensitive to any criticism of his work.
example.zh: 他对任何关于他工作的批评都过度敏感。

senses.en: (medical) having an excessive reaction to a substance; allergic

example.en: Some patients are hypersensitive to certain foods.
example.zh: 有些患者对某些食物过敏。

senses.en: a chemical compound containing iodine

example.en: Potassium iodide is added to some table salt.
example.zh: 有些食盐中添加了碘化钾。

senses.en: an act of pretending or a false appearance

example.en: She made no pretence of liking the gift.
example.zh: 她毫不掩饰自己不喜欢这件礼物。

senses.en: a false claim or excuse

example.en: He entered the office under the pretence of delivering mail.
example.zh: 他借口送信进了办公室。

senses.en: two crossed bones used as a symbol of danger or death

example.en: The sign showed a skull and crossbones.
example.zh: 标志上画着一个骷髅和交叉骨。

senses.en: a person who bets money on games or events

example.en: The casino is full of gamblers hoping to win big.
example.zh: 赌场里满是希望能赢大钱的赌徒。

senses.en: the line where land meets the sea

example.en: The island has a rugged coastline with many cliffs.
example.zh: 这座岛的海岸线崎岖，有许多悬崖。

senses.en: to bring back to life; to revive

example.en: The story tells how the hero resurrects a fallen kingdom.
example.zh: 故事讲述主人公如何复兴一个衰落的王国。

senses.en: to bring back into use or attention

example.en: The band resurrected several old songs for the tour.
example.zh: 乐队在巡演中重新演绎了几首老歌。

senses.en: continuing for a long time or forever and not temporary
senses.zh: 永久的；长期的；非临时的

example.en: The new law will make the change permanent.
example.zh: 新法律将使这一改变成为永久性的。

senses.en: a hairstyle made by curling the hair with chemicals and heat

example.en: She got a permanent before the wedding.
example.zh: 婚礼前她烫了发。

senses.en: approximately; not exactly

example.en: The journey takes roughly two hours.
example.zh: 这段路程大约需要两个小时。

senses.en: in a forceful or not gentle way

example.en: The box was handled roughly during transport.
example.zh: 这个箱子在运输过程中被粗暴搬运。

senses.en: to take legal action against someone in a court

example.en: She sued the company for unfair dismissal.
example.zh: 她因不公平解雇起诉了那家公司。

senses.en: to formally ask for something, especially peace or mercy
senses.zh: 正式请求（尤指和平或宽恕）

example.en: The defeated army sued for peace.
example.zh: 战败的军队请求和平。

senses.en: to say you are sorry for something you did wrong or caused

example.en: She apologized for arriving late.
example.zh: 她为迟到道了歉。

senses.en: to make someone suffer for breaking a rule or law

example.en: The teacher punished the students for being late.
example.zh: 老师因学生迟到而处罚了他们。

senses.en: an act of washing your body in water

example.en: She takes a warm bath every evening before bed.
example.zh: 她每晚睡前都洗个热水澡。

senses.en: a bathtub or a room with a bathtub

example.en: The apartment has one bedroom and a bath.
example.zh: 这套公寓有一间卧室和一个浴室。

senses.en: most important or largest; principal

example.en: The main entrance is on the north side of the building.
example.zh: 主入口位于大楼北侧。

senses.en: a large pipe or cable that carries water, gas, or electricity
senses.zh: （水、燃气或电力的）主管道；干线

example.en: A burst water main flooded the street.
example.zh: 一条破裂的供水主管道淹了街道。

senses.en: A person or animal of the sex that produces sperm.

example.en: The male of the species guards the nest.
example.zh: 该物种的雄性守护巢穴。

senses.en: Relating to men or boys.

example.en: She joined a male-dominated profession.
example.zh: 她加入了一个男性主导的职业。

senses.en: Of the sex that produces sperm or pollen.

example.en: The male flowers appear before the female ones.
example.zh: 雄花先于雌花出现。

senses.en: to hit something with your foot

example.en: She kicked the ball into the goal.
example.zh: 她把球踢进了球门。

senses.en: an act of kicking something

example.en: He gave the door a hard kick.
example.zh: 他狠狠地踢了门一脚。

senses.en: a feeling of excitement or pleasure

example.en: The children get a kick out of riding the roller coaster.
example.zh: 孩子们从坐过山车中获得很大乐趣。

senses.en: the most important or central part of something

example.en: The core of the problem is a lack of trust.
example.zh: 问题的核心是缺乏信任。

senses.en: the central part of a fruit such as an apple, containing seeds

example.en: An apple core can be composted.
example.zh: 苹果核可以堆肥。

senses.en: to remove the central part from a fruit

example.en: Core the apples before slicing them.
example.zh: 切片前把苹果核去掉。

senses.en: to fear or be anxious about something that may happen

example.en: I dread going to the dentist.
example.zh: 我很害怕去看牙医。

senses.en: a strong feeling of fear or anxiety about something that may happen

example.en: She felt a growing dread as the exam approached.
example.zh: 随着考试临近，她的恐惧感越来越强。

senses.en: causing fear or terror (often before a noun, as in 'dread disease')

example.en: In the past, polio was a dread disease.
example.zh: 过去，脊髓灰质炎是一种可怕的疾病。

senses.en: a person who lives by asking others for money or food

example.en: A beggar was sitting at the corner asking for spare change.
example.zh: 一个乞丐坐在街角乞讨零钱。

senses.en: to make someone extremely poor

example.en: The war beggared thousands of families.
example.zh: 战争使成千上万的家庭陷入贫困。

senses.en: to be beyond the ability of something to describe or imagine
senses.zh: 使（描述、想象等）无能为力

example.en: The beauty of the landscape beggars description.
example.zh: 这片风景美得难以形容。

senses.en: the state of always behaving or happening in the same way

example.en: Consistency is important when learning a language.
example.zh: 学习语言时，保持规律、持之以恒很重要。

senses.en: how thick or firm a substance is

example.en: The batter should have a thick, smooth consistency.
example.zh: 面糊应呈浓稠顺滑的状态。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Gregory is studying history at university.
example.zh: 格雷戈里正在大学学习历史。

senses.en: a plant or animal produced from parents of different species or varieties

example.en: The farmer grows a new hybrid of rice.
example.zh: 这位农民种植一种新的水稻杂交品种。

senses.en: a thing made by combining two different elements

example.en: The novel is a hybrid of mystery and science fiction.
example.zh: 这部小说是推理小说与科幻小说的结合体。

senses.en: combining two different things, such as an engine using both petrol and electricity

example.en: She bought a hybrid car to save on fuel.
example.zh: 她买了一辆混合动力车以节省燃油。

senses.en: lasting or happening without stopping or interruption

example.en: The weather forecast promised continued sunshine through the weekend.
example.zh: 天气预报说整个周末将持续晴朗。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of continue; kept going or did not stop
senses.zh: 继续；持续（continue 的过去式和过去分词）

example.en: She continued working after everyone else had gone home.
example.zh: 别人都回家了，她还在继续工作。

senses.en: an idea believed to be true without proof; an assumption

example.en: The theory is based on supposition rather than evidence.
example.zh: 这个理论基于推测而非证据。

senses.en: the art or practice of making portraits

example.en: She studied portraiture at an art school.
example.zh: 她在艺术学校学习肖像画。

senses.en: a vivid or detailed depiction of something, especially in words

example.en: The novel offers a vivid portraiture of rural life.
example.zh: 这部小说生动地刻画了乡村生活。

senses.en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs

example.en: We sat around the kitchen table.
example.zh: 我们围坐在厨房的桌子旁。

senses.en: a set of facts or numbers arranged in rows and columns

example.en: The results are shown in the table below.
example.zh: 结果见下表。

senses.en: (British English) to formally present a proposal for discussion

example.en: She tabled a motion at the meeting.
example.zh: 她在会上正式提交了一项动议。

senses.en: (American English) to postpone discussion of something

example.en: They tabled the proposal until the next meeting.
example.zh: 他们把该提案推迟到下次会议讨论。

senses.en: something said or written in reply to a question

example.en: She gave a clear answer to my question.
example.zh: 她对我的问题给出了明确的回答。

senses.en: to say or write something in reply

example.en: He answered the teacher's question.
example.zh: 他回答了老师的问题。

senses.en: a solution to a problem or puzzle

example.en: We finally found the answer to the puzzle.
example.zh: 我们终于找到了这个谜题的答案。

senses.en: to pick up the phone or open the door when someone calls or knocks

example.en: Could you answer the door, please?
example.zh: 请你开一下门好吗？

senses.en: to add a number to itself a stated number of times; to calculate the product of

example.en: Multiply 6 by 4 and you get 24.
example.zh: 6乘以4等于24。

senses.en: to increase greatly in number or amount

example.en: The company's profits have multiplied in recent years.
example.zh: 近年来公司利润大幅增长。

senses.en: to reproduce; to produce offspring in large numbers

example.en: Bacteria multiply quickly in warm conditions.
example.zh: 细菌在温暖环境下繁殖很快。

senses.en: the number 80; ten more than seventy

example.en: My grandfather is eighty years old.
example.zh: 我爷爷八十岁了。

senses.en: the quality of continuing to try despite difficulties

example.en: Her persistence finally paid off when she got the job.
example.zh: 她的坚持不懈最终得到了回报，她获得了那份工作。

senses.en: the state of continuing to exist or happen for a long time

example.en: The persistence of the drought worried farmers.
example.zh: 干旱的持续让农民们感到担忧。

senses.en: the act of working together with others to create or achieve something

example.en: The project was completed through close collaboration between the two teams.
example.zh: 这个项目是通过两个团队的密切合作完成的。

senses.en: cooperation with an enemy occupying one's country

example.en: He was accused of collaboration with the occupying forces.
example.zh: 他被指控与占领军勾结。

senses.en: a royal headpiece worn by a king or queen, or the monarchy itself as a symbol of power

example.en: The queen wore a golden crown at the ceremony.
example.zh: 女王在典礼上戴着金色的王冠。

senses.en: the top part of the head, a hill, or a tooth

example.en: She felt a pain in the crown of her tooth.
example.zh: 她感到牙冠处疼痛。

senses.en: to formally make someone a king or queen at a ceremony

example.en: They crowned the new king in a grand ceremony.
example.zh: 他们在盛大的仪式上为新国王加冕。

senses.en: having a sharp, acidic taste like lemon or vinegar

example.en: The lemonade tastes too sour for me.
example.zh: 这柠檬汁对我来说太酸了。

senses.en: smelling or tasting spoiled, especially milk or food gone off

example.en: The milk has gone sour, so don't drink it.
example.zh: 牛奶已经发馊了，别喝。

senses.en: to become, or to make, a relationship, mood, or situation unpleasant

example.en: Their friendship soured after the argument.
example.zh: 那次争吵后，他们的友谊变坏了。

senses.en: a cocktail made with liquor, lemon or lime juice, and sugar

example.en: He ordered a whiskey sour at the bar.
example.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯威士忌酸酒。

senses.en: a device that connects an electrical appliance to a power supply

example.en: The lamp cord has a three-pin plug.
example.zh: 这盏灯的电线有一个三脚插头。

senses.en: a stopper used to block a hole

example.en: She pulled the plug out of the sink to drain the water.
example.zh: 她拔掉水槽里的塞子把水放掉。

senses.en: to fill or close a hole tightly; to connect something into a socket

example.en: Plug the charger into the wall socket.
example.zh: 把充电器插到墙上的插座里。

senses.en: to work hard at something

example.en: He plugged away at his homework all evening.
example.zh: 他整晚都在埋头做作业。

senses.en: to come or happen before something else in time, order, or position
senses.zh: 在……之前（发生或出现）；先于

example.en: A short speech preceded the award ceremony.
example.zh: 颁奖典礼前有一段简短的致辞。

collocations: precede something by a few minutes
the events that preceded the war

senses.en: a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost

example.en: The children got lost in the garden maze.
example.zh: 孩子们在花园迷宫里迷路了。

senses.en: to sit or lie with the arms and legs spread out carelessly
senses.zh: 伸开手脚懒散地躺（或坐）

example.en: He was sprawled on the sofa watching TV.
example.zh: 他四肢摊开躺在沙发上看电视。

senses.en: the uncontrolled spread of a city into the surrounding area

example.en: Urban sprawl has swallowed much of the countryside.
example.zh: 城市无序扩张吞噬了大片乡村。

senses.en: to spread out in an irregular or untidy way

example.en: The city sprawls for miles along the coast.
example.zh: 这座城市沿海岸绵延数英里。

senses.en: to collect or earn something, such as attention, support, or praise

example.en: The film garnered praise from critics around the world.
example.zh: 这部电影赢得了全世界评论家的赞誉。

senses.en: a scientist who studies how living things relate to their environment

example.en: The ecologist studied how the wetland plants respond to pollution.
example.zh: 这位生态学家研究湿地植物如何应对污染。

senses.en: very particular or fussy about small details, especially about food

example.en: My cat is finicky and refuses most brands of food.
example.zh: 我的猫很挑剔，大多数品牌的食物都不肯吃。

senses.en: a short high electronic sound, often covering offensive words

example.en: The swear words were replaced with a bleep on the radio.
example.zh: 广播里脏话被哔哔声遮盖了。

senses.en: to cover a sound with a short high tone

example.en: The TV censors bleeped the rude word.
example.zh: 电视审查人员把粗话屏蔽成了哔声。

senses.en: a ladle with a cup and long handle for scooping liquid

example.en: She used a dipper to scoop water from the bucket.
example.zh: 她用长柄勺从桶里舀水。

senses.en: a group of seven bright stars (the Big Dipper or Little Dipper)

example.en: The Big Dipper is easy to find in the night sky.
example.zh: 北斗七星在夜空中很容易找到。

senses.en: always reliable and never weakening
senses.zh: 始终可靠的；经久不衰的

example.en: She thanked him for his unfailing support.
example.zh: 她感谢他始终不渝的支持。

senses.en: never running out; endless

example.en: He seemed to have an unfailing supply of jokes.
example.zh: 他似乎有用不完的笑话。

senses.en: all the animal life of a particular region or period

example.en: The island is home to a rich and varied fauna.
example.zh: 这座岛拥有丰富多样的动物群。

senses.en: to wave or shake something, especially a weapon, threateningly

example.en: The guard brandished a flashlight to scare off the intruder.
example.zh: 警卫挥动手电筒吓退了闯入者。

senses.en: the fashion or style that is popular at a particular time

example.en: Short hair came into vogue last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天短发开始流行起来。

senses.en: the highest point or most successful period of something

example.en: The empire reached its zenith in the sixteenth century.
example.zh: 该帝国在十六世纪达到鼎盛。

collocations: at the zenith of one's career

senses.en: the point in the sky directly above an observer

example.en: The sun was almost at its zenith at noon.
example.zh: 正午时太阳几乎位于天顶。

senses.en: places where people can buy and eat meals

example.en: Several new restaurants opened near the harbor this year.
example.zh: 今年港口附近新开了几家餐馆。

senses.en: partly melted into a soft liquid state

example.en: The rock inside the volcano is semimolten.
example.zh: 火山内部的岩石处于半熔化状态。
